text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. Now then, I shall list ten 
of Royce-san's great qualities.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set, go♪ Ro-ro-ro-Royce♪ Acting 
skills—whoosh! Real face—swoon!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ro-ro-ro-royce♪ Punctual♪ Meticulous♪ 
Organized♪ Neat handwriting♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ro-ro-ro-royce♪ Self-produ-sh... Aahh, I 
stumbled over my words~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ro-ro-ro-royce♪ Observant♪ 
Self-disciplined♪ Great research skills♪ 
Tech-savvy♪ Glasses♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that was our birthday present to you~! 
I tripped over my words a tiny bit, but be 
sure to make good use of it for your 
self-producing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fufu, fufufufu...! Thank you very 
much! Both of you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's so true, that's just how I am. I 
always end up stealing people's hearts 
without even trying~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now this is the mark of the strongest! I 
truly am destined to become the strongest 
Umamusume—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. They seemed way more... thrilled 
than I expected, so I'm really glad~!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes, that's what matters most. 
Royce-san, please have a wonderful 
birthday.
